name: AW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The top belt, listed as Tier I. Kaige won it in a three-way at HalloWicked 2K7 and Alexander Caine vacated it on 13 December 2007. The fed calls Morrigan, who won it in the All Nite Action 1 cell on 29 July 2008, its first champion since Kaige; Jason Lovell took it at Cold Fall on 21 September 2008. The 2010 page lists it vacant on 1 January 2010 and Dave Wilson champion from the Rabbithole of Idus Martias.

name: North American Championship
epitaph: Listed as Tier II, open to anyone. Morrigan won it in a three-way at HalloWicked 2K7 and defended it three times in November and December 2007; the fed awarded it to him again on 7 April 2008 and Morgan Call took it from him at Blunt Trauma on 20 April. It was vacated on 29 July 2008, listed vacant again on 1 January 2010 and won by Devlin Raine in the scramble match of 17 January 2010.

name: Iron Man Championship
epitaph: Listed as Tier V in 2008 and retired on 1 January 2010: a belt whose holder had to defend it at every event. James Caine, Madison Divera and Spaz Blud held it in November and December 2007; Suriel N. Crowlie won it at Noitcerusser I and The Diablo Slayer took it from him on 12 August 2008. The Iron Man and No Limit belts were combined into the Untamed Championship at Cold Fall on 21 September 2008.
notes: No holder is listed between Spaz Blud in December 2007 and Suriel N. Crowlie in July 2008.

events.note: Its record says it was 'combined to new title' on 21 September 2008.
events.title: aw-anarchy-2008-untamed

name: Chaos Theory Championships
epitaph: The fed's tag-team belts, introduced on the night of All Nite Action 2 when Jon Tees handed them to Matt Ward and Suriel N. Crowlie. Vinny Vegas and Maxx Kalifornia are said by the All Nite Action V card to have won them at Cold Fall; the belts were vacant on 1 January 2010, and Scott Owens and Morrigan won them by beating Parental Advisory in the thumbtacks, ladders and wire match at Idus Martias.
notes: The Idus Martias card says Owens and Payne once 'cost Parental Advisory the championships'; no page says whether Parental Advisory ever held them, and the 2010 champions page lists the belts vacant from 1 January 2010 until that match.

name: Untamed Championship
epitaph: Described as the fed's basic hardcore title, with a defence required at every Action. The Diablo Slayer won it when the No Limit and Iron Man belts were combined at Cold Fall on 21 September 2008, and the page of 2010 shows it awarded to him again on 1 January 2010; he defended it against Jesse Williams at All Nite Action IX.

name: No Limit Championship
epitaph: Created by Jon Tees after Blunt Trauma for lighter wrestlers, weighing no more than 219 pounds. The Noitcerusser I glass match for it ended in a draw and the belt stayed vacant; Breeze was its first and only champion on 26 August 2008, and it was combined into the Untamed Championship at Cold Fall on 21 September 2008.
notes: The page of 2010 also lists the belt as retired on 1 January 2010.

events.note: Its record says it was 'combined to new title' on 21 September 2008.

name: EWA Tag Team Championships
epitaph: The EWA's tag belts, listed as Tier IV: Devestation Inc. won them at HalloWicked 2K7, Dog House took them on 12 November 2007 and defended them against Damage Co. on 2 December, and Beauty & the Beast took them on 13 December 2007. No later tag belt carries them on; the Chaos Theory Championships began vacant.
